page.overview:
Who is Denise Beam?

Denise Beam is one of the minor characters in Cars 2.

Denise Beam appears to be a tea green car with copper eyes.

Denise Beam is one of the many audience members in the World Grand Prix, and is a huge Carla Veloso fan.

Denise Beam is also seen in the men's restroom, due to the fact that multiple of these characters are seen.
